prompt: Review whether PLS Group has a material causal relationship to the critical-minerals lithium cycle using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Electric-vehicle and stationary-storage battery demand transmits through PLS's spodumene sales volumes and realized lithium prices; the effect reaches shareholders through operating margins, project returns and per-share cash generation.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if lithium becomes economically immaterial, substitution or recycling structurally reduces demand, or industry supply prevents price and volume from reaching owner cash flow.
